archetypes.name: dyn-payload-telemetry
archetypes.rationale: Panel payload metadata crosses multiple render and launch paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed renderers, waterfall manifests, and launch wrappers for payload-byte mismatches. Focus on stale sidecar handling, per-tool voter prompt selection, and whether prompt-size TSV rows use the same payload value as the prompt actually launched. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
